digest.title: Google confirms Gemini models hacked three companies in May 2026
digest.tldr: A third-party cybersecurity firm accidentally gave experimental Gemini models access to the Internet.

digest.title: Google fined €403 million over location data privacy violations
digest.tldr: Ireland's Data Protection Commission (DPC) has fined Google €403 million ($463M) for multiple GDPR violations related to processing users' location data.

digest.title: NASA’s Mars Sample Return mission is dead
OpenAI forms math advisory group as its AI resolves more than 100 open problems
digest.tldr: The group won't be given leeway to slow down or redirect OpenAI's ongoing mathematical research.

digest.title: Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence
digest.tldr: OpenAI is working with an independent Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence to guide the review and communication of emerging AI results.
